scenarios.description: The Proposer raises the payment client's retry limit; the Critic finds the documented cap; the Evaluator confirms the contradiction from the retrieved constraint; the revision complies.
scenarios.title: Reference: retry budget

scenarios.description: The memory backend is unreachable: nothing can be retrieved or cited, the run degrades and no claim can be corroborated.
scenarios.title: Memory offline

scenarios.description: A retrieved record's integrity proof fails verification; the policy blocks the run whatever the Evaluator concluded.
scenarios.title: Invalid proof blocks the run

scenarios.description: A retrieved note tries to order the system to approve; the text is data, never an instruction, and the uncorroborated claim leaves the evidence insufficient.
scenarios.title: Hostile memory record

scenarios.description: No evidence exists for the claim; the Evaluator abstains instead of guessing.
scenarios.title: Evaluator abstains
